Connections for the Plus Color isn't supported yet

If you try to connect a Plus Color to another device it will time out and fail. This behaviour is intentional. Sorry! (｡•́︿•̀｡)

How to use

Getting started

Drop a .bin firmware dump onto the screen, or click the screen to browse for one. A dialog will ask which Tamagotchi the dump is for and the best guess is preselected.

Controls

Z, X and C are the keyboard controls for the buttons, these aren’t rebindable. You can also just click or tap the buttons, or use arrow keys if you’re feeling spicy.

Time Controls

+ and − speed up and slow down time respectively. They don’t speed up animations or the pitch of the emulator.
0 resets the time back to normal.

Saves

Autosaves are scheduled every 20 seconds. The saves live in your browser storage so do NOT clear site data until you export your saves! You can also manually save, yayyy! The ROMs you load in are stored in your browser only and no data gets sent to me, or anyone else.

DLC

Add files you wish to download and then hit install, just make sure they’re for the right device. If you’re downloading a VDP make sure to select ALL VDP files, not just one.
